studioCat: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production sprite atlas for BARCODE: System Override, a gritty 1990s side-scrolling hip-hop broadcast game. Make a 1024x1024 transparent PNG atlas containing a FOUR-FRAME WALK CYCLE of ONE ordinary scruffy tuxedo CAT, facing RIGHT, arranged in an exact 2x2 grid of equal 512x512 cells. Studio Rat is slang for this CAT, not a rodent. Character: lean short-haired charcoal black alley cat, white muzzle/chest and white front socks, angular feline ears, green eyes, long furry curved cat tail. Real feline anatomy, four legs, no clothing, no headphones, no human features, no extra props. Hand-pixelled late-SNES/Genesis comic sprite look, chunky readable clusters, dark ink outline and sharp cel highlights, limited 12-16-color palette. Slightly mischievous, alert. Whole side-profile cat body and complete tail fit inside each cell with ample clear padding. In every cell the cat has identical size, anatomy, head height and right-facing direction; the feet baseline is 425px within the cell; body spans roughly x95 to410 with tail reaching x45, head around x385. Four successive distinct walking foot poses in reading order: contact, passing, opposite contact, opposite passing; same center of mass, mild natural head bob only. Isolated cutouts with true alpha transparency everywhere outside the cat, including between legs and inside tail curve. No floor, shadows, background, checkerboard, grid lines, lettering, labels, frame numbers or watermark. This is a sprite sheet to be sliced into four equal cells, not a concept sheet with differently sized cats.
directionArrow: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable in-game directional arrow sprite for BARCODE: System Override, a grimy 1990s side-scrolling hip-hop / damaged public-access broadcast game. Generate ONE large right-pointing arrow, isolated on genuinely transparent alpha background. Orthographic FLAT side view, strictly points RIGHT horizontally, recognizable at 80 pixels wide. Broad chunky arrowhead and short thick shaft, bold irregular charcoal-black ink silhouette. Distressed bone-white paper/stencilled-metal fill, a lime-green stripe following the top edge, small violet misregistered offset fragments along the lower edge. A few BARCODE-like vertical black cuts in the shaft and chipped corners; no readable lettering. Make this feel like a torn handmade comic panel instruction hijacked into a game HUD. Sharp chunky hand-pixelled/cel-shaded edges, 1990s sprite artistry, clear silhouette with empty cutouts. Main arrow shape occupies the center 80% of a wide 3:2 composition with generous transparent border; very small broken fragments may remain close to its edges. No glow cloud, blur, gradient, 3D perspective, circle, button, text, watermark, background, checkerboard, ground or shadow. One arrow asset only, not an illustration or mockup.
bossPulse: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a FOUR-FRAME animated ground-attack sprite atlas for BARCODE: System Override. ONE jagged ground-skimming ENERGY PULSE moving RIGHT, four successive animation frames in exact 2x2 equal cells on a square transparent PNG. This attack belongs to a huge purple sinewy corrupted creature with glowing cyan fissures and claws. No creature is included in this asset. Each frame: a fiercely angular hot ivory/amber leading slash on the RIGHT, violet torn wake and a few cyan fracture streaks streaming to the LEFT, opaque chunky central core, serrated torn edges, broken black-ink accents, small isolated angular chips near the main pulse. A compact roughly square burst with its bottom straight enough to visibly skim a pavement, 1990s arcade sprite/cel pixel art, energetic hand-drawn asymmetric attack rather than a fireball, neon circle or magic aura. Four distinctly changing serrations and wake folds, the same overall size and silhouette direction across cells, identical center and ground baseline. Keep artwork inside the central 80% of each cell with clear padding between frames. Color restriction: bone white hot core, amber/orange readable hazard edge, bruised purple/violet wake and tiny cyan cuts, black outlines. Strong readable front even when rendered at 64x56 pixels; restrained detached ornamentation. Genuinely transparent alpha background, transparent negative spaces. No backgrounds, floor, drop shadow, fuzzy glow cloud, checkerboard, circles, smoke ball, grids, words, labels, frame numbers or watermarks. Four animation frames of the SAME single pulse; not four different weapons. Ground baseline at 85% of each cell height.
